label: NSD3::NUTM1

sections.text: NSD3 encodes a chromatin regulator with isoforms that interact with transcriptional machinery.
NUTM1 encodes a normally testis-enriched protein that interacts with the acetyltransferase p300.

The fusion recruits NUTM1 into a BRD-associated chromatin complex and promotes p300-dependent acetylation, maintaining proliferation and blocking differentiation. NSD3::NUTM1 is an established alternative driver of NUT carcinoma.
In a retrospective NUT carcinoma cohort, nonthoracic BRD3/NSD3-fused tumors had better survival than nonthoracic BRD4-fused tumors; thoracic site remained an adverse feature.
